req.title: Delete cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall expire cookies named in the query string of GET /cookies/delete and redirect to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The delete_cookies handler at GET /cookies/delete reads cookie names from the query string, calls r.delete_cookie(key=key) for each, and returns a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path – named cookie is expired via Set-Cookie with past expiration and a 302 redirect to /cookies is issued; (2) negative path – no query params yields a 302 with no Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary – deleting multiple cookies at once; (4) state transition – cookie exists before delete, is absent after following redirect; (5) decision table – deleting a cookie that was never set still returns 302 with expired Set-Cookie header. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value (/cookies), exact Set-Cookie expiration semantics (expires in the past), and exact cookie absence after deletion.

tests.name: test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expired_set_cookie
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
A cookie named 'session' exists in the request
expected: Set-Cookie header for 'session' contains an expiration date in the past (expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: system shall expire cookies named in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expired_set_cookie():
    # First set the cookie
    r_set = client.get('/cookies/set/session/abc', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r_set.status_code == 200

    # Now delete it without following redirect
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?session=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

    # Verify Set-Cookie header expires the cookie
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) >= 1
    matched = any('session' in h and ('1970' in h or 'expires' in h.lower()) for h in set_cookie_headers)
    assert matched, f'Expected expired Set-Cookie for session, got: {set_cookie_headers}'

test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expired_set_cookie()

tests.name: test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_response
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Multiple cookies (alpha, beta, gamma) are set
actions: Set cookies alpha=1, beta=2, gamma=3 via /cookies/set
expected: Three Set-Cookie headers present, one per cookie, each with past expiration
After following redirect to /cookies, none of the three cookies appear in JSON
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: all cookies named in query string must be expired
BVA: boundary at N=3 cookies deleted simultaneously
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_response():
    client.get('/cookies/set?alpha=1&beta=2&gamma=3', follow_redirects=True)

    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?alpha=&beta=&gamma=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 3, f'Expected 3 Set-Cookie headers, got {len(set_cookie_headers)}'

    names_expired = [h.split('=')[0].strip() for h in set_cookie_headers]
    assert 'alpha' in names_expired
    assert 'beta' in names_expired
    assert 'gamma' in names_expired

    r2 = client.get('/cookies', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    import json
    data = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert 'alpha' not in data.get('cookies', {})
    assert 'beta' not in data.get('cookies', {})
    assert 'gamma' not in data.get('cookies', {})

test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_response()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_delete
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Set cookie token=xyz via /cookies/set/token/xyz following redirect
Verify cookie is absent in /cookies response
expected: Delete response status code is exactly 200 after following redirect
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: state transition from cookie-present to cookie-absent
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_delete():
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        pass

    r_set = client.get('/cookies/set/token/xyz', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r_set.status_code == 200
    data_before = json.loads(r_set.data)
    assert data_before.get('cookies', {}).get('token') == 'xyz'

    r_del = client.get('/cookies/delete?token=', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r_del.status_code == 200
    data_after = json.loads(r_del.data)
    assert 'token' not in data_after.get('cookies', {}), \
        f'token should be absent after delete, got: {data_after}'

test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_delete()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies_not_other_path
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Inspect Location header value character by character
expected: Location header value is exactly the string '/cookies'
Location header is NOT '/cookies/delete', NOT '/cookie', NOT '/cookies/'
Status code is exactly 302, not 301, not 303, not 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: redirect target must be /cookies exactly
BVA: boundary between correct path /cookies and near-miss paths
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies_not_other_path():
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?x=1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies', f'Expected /cookies, got "{location}"'
    assert location != '/cookies/', 'Location must not have trailing slash'
    assert location != '/cookies/delete', 'Location must not be /cookies/delete'
    assert location != '/cookie', 'Location must not be /cookie'
